layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Therizinosaurid proto-feather morphology
features: A close-up of a dinosaur's shoulder and neck covered in shaggy clay proto-feathers
The feathers look like long, thick, hair-like filaments made of individual rolled clay strands
The texture is coarse and tactile, layered to look like a thick, insulating coat
Colors are a mix of deep umber and sienna clay, with some lighter cream-colored tips
The underlying skin is visible in small gaps, showing a pebbled clay texture
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic macro shot focusing on the 'shaggy' texture of the proto-feathers. The lighting emphasizes the individual strands and the depth of the coat. This serves as a 'Proto-feathers' morphology icon. No text.
